questionnaire.name: PHQ-9
questionnaire.description: Questionnaire about depressive symptoms over the last two weeks.

item_1.label: Little interest or pleasure in doing things

item_3.label: Trouble falling or staying asleep, or sleeping too much

item_4.label: Feeling tired or having little energy

item_6.label: Feeling bad about yourself or that you are a failure or have let yourself or your family down

item_7.label: Trouble concentrating on things, such as reading the newspaper or watching television

item_8.label: Moving or speaking so slowly that other people could have noticed, or the opposite: being fidgety or restless

item_9.label: Thoughts that you would be better off dead or of hurting yourself

severity_class_5.description: Five-level severity category derived from the total PHQ-9 score.
